description: Put a life event on an athlete's calendar: a night shift, a wedding, a week of travel, a cold. Not a session — it carries no load — but what the days it covers can hold, less than usual or more. impact says how much: no_training (nothing), easy_only (no quality), short_only (nothing over about 75 minutes), tired (as planned, but do not stack quality the next day), as_planned (only the sports in cannot change), more_time (a camp or a day off: long days and doubles welcome). cannot lists sports the days rule out, in any impact. The plan response carries the events as life_events beside the sessions, and audit_plan holds a drafted week against them. Athletes can add their own from their portal or their own connector.

athlete_id.description: May be omitted when you coach exactly one athlete.

cannot.description: Sports these days rule out, whatever the impact: ["run"] for a sore knee, ["swim"] for a hotel with no pool. The planner swaps them rather than dropping the session.

ends_on.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Omit for a single day.

impact.description: no_training: no session at all on these days; easy_only: easy work only — no quality session; short_only: nothing longer than about an hour and a quarter; tired: training as planned, but expect it to feel harder; do not stack quality the day after; as_planned: as much as planned; only the sports in `cannot` are out on these days — swap them, do not drop them; more_time: more room than usual: long sessions and double days are welcome, within the week's load envelope

title.description: A few words, as it should read on the calendar

name: add_life_event
